visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt featuring a red 'No Monkey' strike-through graphic and a dark denim skirt, sits slumped in a black mesh office chair. She holds a silver smartphone, staring at the screen with a look of extreme boredom and a slight pout. The background is a dark wall covered in white mathematical formulas and diagrams, illuminated by soft indoor lighting. (2) A bald man wearing a matching white graphic t-shirt and a thick silver chain necklace enters the frame, leaning towards the woman. He gestures with his hands while appearing to speak animatedly. A second man with glasses is briefly visible in the background, also wearing the same uniform shirt. They are situated in an indoor space with Mahjong tables and typical parlor furniture. (3) The scene shifts to a different woman with long black hair wearing a dark blue hoodie, sitting at a blue automatic Mahjong table. She reaches out with her right hand to draw a tile, her facial expression shifting from focused concentration to a wide, triumphant smile as she reveals her hand. (4) The bald man and the woman in the hoodie engage in a discussion over the Mahjong table. The man points at the tiles and then to his head, his face contorted in an expression of authoritative explanation. Vertical text warnings appear on the left side. The camera uses close-ups to capture their facial expressions and the arrangement of tiles. (5) The woman in the hoodie draws a final tile and places it down firmly. The camera zooms in on her hand, showing a rare 'Big Four Happiness' combination. The bald man looks stunned, placing his palm over his eyes in a gesture of humorous defeat. The video ends with a black screen and credit scroll.
